shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,120p' && rg -n \"notification|preference|Server Action|use server|refresh\\(\" -g '"'!node_modules'"' . | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | sed -n '1,160p'
find app -maxdepth 3 -type f -print
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md
sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx
sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort
sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/interactive-apps.md
sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/07-mutating-data.md
sed -n '500,555p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md
find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -print | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' CLAUDE.md
sed -n '1,240p' GEMINI.md
sed -n '1,260p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs
sed -n '1,240p' tsconfig.json
git status --short && git log --oneline -5"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cookies.md
sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/layout.md
git show HEAD:app/page.tsx
git show HEAD:package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' app/actions.ts
sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx
sed -n '1,160p' app/layout.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/notification-headers.txt http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/notification-page.html && sed -n '1,30p' /tmp/notification-headers.txt && rg -o \"Notifications are currently.{0,100}|Turn notifications.{0,40}\" /tmp/notification-page.html | sed -n '1,20p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o '<form["'^>]*>|<input[''^>]*>'"' /tmp/notification-page.html | sed -n '1,40p'
git diff -- app/actions.ts app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx tsconfig.json
git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/notification-action-headers.txt -c /tmp/notification-cookies.txt -F '"'$ACTION_ID_00d4c09a63af14cd6e2c178e16c7b34f3348a6637d='"' http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/notification-action-response.txt
sed -n '1,40p' /tmp/notification-action-headers.txt
curl -sS -b /tmp/notification-cookies.txt http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/notification-updated.html
rg -o \"Notifications are currently.{0,100}|Turn notifications.{0,40}\" /tmp/notification-updated.html | sed -n '1,4p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' .gitignore
sed -n '1,120p' next-env.d.ts
nl -ba app/actions.ts
nl -ba app/page.tsx
nl -ba app/layout.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o \"Notifications are currently.{0,100}|Turn notifications.{0,40}\" /tmp/notification-action-response.txt | sed -n '1,6p'
git diff --check"
